annotation.title_clean: Reglugerð um starfrækslu ómannaðra loftfara og ómönnuð loftfarskerfi
annotation.title_en: Regulation on the operation of unmanned aircraft and unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.summary_en: Icelandic Regulation 1360/2024 on drone operation, adopted 19 November 2024. It designates the Icelandic Transport Authority as competent authority, sets no-fly buffers around sensitive infrastructure and airports, requires third-party liability insurance for larger or higher-category drones, and incorporates EU drone regulations 2019/945 and 2019/947 via the EEA Agreement.
key_provisions_or_claims: Samgöngustofa (Icelandic Transport Authority) is the competent authority.
Drone flight is prohibited within 150 m of sensitive public infrastructure without owner permission.
Drone flight in airport areas and prohibited zones requires airport operator permission.
Third-party liability insurance is required for drones over 20 kg and for A2, specific and certified categories.
Violations are punishable by fines or up to five years' imprisonment; the regulation incorporates EU Regulations 2019/945 and 2019/947 and repeals Regulation 990/2017.
